title_en: What the Pit Keeps: The Record

commands.speaker: ac_mera_holt
commands.text: The rim is marked. No names guessed, no bodies moved without a witness.

commands.speaker: ac_tovin_reed
commands.text: I can remember eleven workers. Not all their families.

commands.speaker: jori_flint
commands.text: Then eleven is where we start, not where we stop.

commands.speaker: ac_mera_holt
commands.text: I will leave the list open. Anyone missing may be written here without proving what they earned.
The first new sign at the pit forbids a load. The second asks a question: Who is still missing?

commands.speaker: ac_tovin_reed
commands.text: I should have asked that before there was a pit.
